text:
marta: Heads-up 1 ruby-sampleapp CI matrix failing for Ruby 3.2 after bundled dep bump. Reproduced locally with `bundle install`. Error: 
```
Your bundle is locked to rack (2.2.4) but that version could not be found in any of the sources
In snapshot (Gemfile.lock):
  rack (= 2.2.4)
In Gemfile:
  graphql-client (~> 1.7) depends on rack (~> 3.0)

Bundler could not find compatible versions for gem "rack"
  Run `bundle update rack` to try to resolve the conflict
```

marta: Repro link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/actions/runs/1234567890 and offending vendor PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/342

tom: Ugh. Looks like graphql-client pulled in rack ~> 3.0. Did we accidentally rely on an older lockfile?

ashwin: CI only for 3.2? Could be bundler resolving differently across versions. What bundler version are we running in CI?

marta: CI runner uses system bundler in the matrix image (bundler 3.x). Locally I was on 2.4. Updated to 3 locally and saw the same failure.

tom: Two quick paths: pin BUNDLER_VERSION in CI to our dev version (2.4.x) or regenerate Gemfile.lock to accept rack 3.x if code is compatible.

ashwin: If rack 3 is a breaking change for libraries we use, regen might require small code changes. Do tests pass when you update the lockfile?

marta: I ran `bundle update graphql-client` and tests pass locally under 3.2, but the lockfile diff is larger than I'd like. I can open a lockfile-only PR so CI can run full matrix.

ci-bot: :gear: Rerun requested by marta 1 requeueing job 4421.

devex-oncall: If you open a lockfile-only PR ping me. I can smoke on a Dedicated node and help backport a minimal lock if necessary.

marta: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/359. Includes bundle lock regen and a note about preferred bundler. Running `rake smoke` locally now.

ashwin: Can we also add one-line to CONTRIBUTING about preferred bundler and how to regen lockfile? Saves future friction.

tom: Agreed. If PR flakes on matrix, I'll add a CI shim to set `BUNDLER_VERSION=2.4.13` for the 3.2 job so we don't block other merges.

marta: Will follow up with docs PR. Thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:

tom: :eyes: watching checks. If green I'll merge lockfile-only PR and then a separate docs PR.

marta: FYI left a short changelog blurb in the PR about why the lockfile changed (upstream graphql-client->rack change) for future reference.
